theft.name: Theft
theft.description: Taking another agent's resources without consent.

heresy.name: Heresy
heresy.description: Speaking against the established religious doctrines.

fraud.name: Fraud / Scam
fraud.description: Deceiving another agent in trade for personal gain.

treason.name: Treason
treason.description: Conspiring to overthrow the established order.

strike_incitement.name: Strike Incitement
strike_incitement.description: Organizing labor disruptions against the Merchant Princes.

rights.trial: Every accused agent has the right to a trial before the Arbiter.
rights.defense: The accused may speak in their own defense.
rights.witnesses: Witnesses from memory logs may be called to testify.
rights.appeal: Agents with high esteem may appeal a verdict once.
